summary.intent: Bundle three pending todos (#5 share itemName encryption, #8 shared-folder SDK writes, #9 remove redundant web folder-seeding) into a new GSD Phase 48, plan it, and execute Wave 1 (the P0 self-bootstrap regression fix from PR #498) autonomously while AFK — including dispatching the web-e2e acceptance gate against the feature branch.
summary.outcome: Phase 48 was created, researched, and planned (6 plans / 3 waves). Wave 1's `loadFolder` sequence-guard was implemented and greened the version-restore regression (`full-workflow 6.6.2`), but `bin-restore-after-reload.spec.ts` remained red after 3 dispatch cycles. The session was parked at the REQ-1 gate per the agreed rule; all prior fixes and a corrected root-cause diagnosis were committed and pushed.

repo: web-e2e only auto-triggers via ci-e2e.yml on `push: branches: [main]` — PRs and feature branches never get it automatically, which is how #498's regression shipped undetected.

web-e2e.yml is independently `workflow_dispatch`-enabled with `ref: ${{ inputs.ref || github.sha }}` — running `gh workflow run web-e2e.yml --ref <branch>` is the pre-merge acceptance gate and requires no CI plumbing changes.
Phase 47 covered owned-folder SDK consolidation; Phase 48 is the logical successor for shared-folder state, itemName crypto, and the #498 regression.
The recurring `UQ_folder_ipns_user_ipns` duplicate-key server error appears in passing tests and is background noise, not a cause of the bin-restore failure.
CRDT/IPNS inbox research todo (#2) would subsume the itemName ECIES fix (#5) if it shipped, but is explicitly long-horizon and was deferred out of Phase 48 scope.

GSD branching_strategy 'phase' silently creates a new branch off HEAD during `execute-phase` init — it created `feat/sdk-self-bootstrap-regression-fix-and-shared-folder-metadata` alongside the manually-created `feat/phase-48-...`, leaving a stale branch pointer.

The 1Password SSH signer can wedge mid-run with 'failed to fill whole buffer' — disable with `git config commit.gpgsign false` to avoid blocking unattended runs; re-enable and rebase-resign before merge.

CI logs for web-e2e do not capture browser console output; Playwright failure artifacts (error-context.md, trace, screenshot) must be downloaded from the Actions artifact store to diagnose test failures reliably.
TypeORM migrations for this repo run via `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run`; REQ-4 (itemName ECIES) requires a new additive migration cloned from `1743000000000-AddWritableShares.ts`.

code.finding: loadFolder calls `folderTree.set()` unconditionally — self-bootstrap (PR #498) clobbers fresher in-memory state with a stale IPNS snapshot. Fix: insert a sequenceNumber guard before this call.
ensureFolderLoaded has a short-circuit at :422 and a DFS child-check at :454 that must remain intact when adding the sequenceNumber guard to avoid re-regressing #498.

loadBin treats a null return from resolveIpnsRecord as 'bin is empty' and eagerly publishes an empty bin record with no expectedSequenceNumber. On transient post-reload 404s (IPNS propagation lag), this unconditionally clobbers the real bin record server-side — the true root cause of bin-restore-after-reload failing.

Catch block calls navigate('/files') guarded only by latestNavTarget, which a sidebar click to /bin does not update — can bounce /bin → /files when a stale subfolder resolve fails. Guarded with a latestPathname ref, but the bounce persisted, indicating a second redirect source.
Additional navigate('/files') call in useFolderNavigation; both :167 and :307 are candidates for the /bin → /files bounce.
Session restore effect — ruled out as the bounce source; :465 is the MFA REQUIRED_SHARE path only.
push: branches: [main] auto-trigger calls web-e2e via workflow_call. This is the only automatic path — no PR trigger exists.
Directly workflow_dispatch-enabled with `ref: ${{ inputs.ref || github.sha }}`. Direct dispatch resolves repo secrets without a secrets: inherit parent, faithfully reproducing the main-push job.

workflow: Playwright trace files (not just error-context.md) contain console logs and network events — greping them for console output and HTTP status codes is the fastest way to identify test failures without a browser. Three incorrect hypotheses were ruled out only after inspecting the trace.
For unattended multi-hour runs, use sequential execution on the feature branch rather than parallel worktrees — fewer failure modes and all commits land predictably.
When a spec never passed on main, check whether it was introduced by the same PR being fixed — the precondition for the fix may not hold yet.

Distinguish 'do together' (same branch, same lift) from 'one supersedes the other' (cross-link and decide independently) when grouping related todos — conflating them leads to holding a live security finding hostage to a quarters-out research idea.

A Playwright failure screenshot showing the wrong page (Files instead of Bin) is a faster signal than code inspection — the presence/absence of the target route tells you immediately whether the fix is at the data or navigation layer.

friction: 1Password SSH signer wedged mid-run ('failed to fill whole buffer'), forcing unsigned commits from fe646fd5f onward and requiring manual re-signing/admin-merge before the branch can land.

Three web-e2e dispatch cycles (~12-15 min each) were burned on incorrect root-cause hypotheses (SDK clobber, bin auto-repair re-resolve, nav-redirect guard) before the Playwright trace gave definitive ground truth.

CI logs do not capture browser console output, so the bin auto-repair log line ('Bin IPNS record not found — auto-repairing with empty bin') was invisible until the trace artifact was downloaded and grepped — the first two fix attempts were made blind.
GSD branching_strategy 'phase' silently switched the working branch during execute-phase init, creating confusion about which branch was canonical.
A stream idle timeout killed one agent response mid-execution, requiring the user to re-invoke the phase skill from scratch.

Option 1 (REQ-2 web-nav removal) was proposed and agreed to, but Playwright trace evidence gathered immediately after showed it would have been wrong — the trace should have been inspected before proposing options.
open_items: bin-restore-after-reload.spec.ts root cause is IPNS durability in loadBin: null-as-empty-bin causes a destructive publish on transient 404s even after the re-resolve fix. Needs a robust guard (e.g., retry with exponential backoff before publishing empty, or require at least N consecutive 404s).

REQ-1 web-e2e gate is still red — the branch is parked with diagnosis in 48-REQ1-BLOCKED-HANDOFF.md. The corrected root cause (bin IPNS clobber on transient 404) needs a new targeted fix and re-dispatch.

Waves 2-3 not executed: REQ-2 (remove ~16 web ensureFolderRegistered seeders, gated on REQ-1 green), REQ-3 (sharedFolderTree SDK client), REQ-4 (itemName ECIES ECIES column + migration + lazy backfill + invite flow).

Unsigned commits from fe646fd5f onward need re-signing (git rebase --exec 'git commit --amend --no-edit -S') or admin-merge before the branch lands. Re-enable signing with `git config commit.gpgsign true` after restarting 1Password.
Post-green review pipeline not run: /simplify, /gsd:validate-phase 48, CodeRabbit CLI, /security:review (ECIES itemName wrap, IPNS sequence reconcile, shared-folder state).
PR to main not opened — gated on web-e2e green.
